listing.summary: This mod adds industry. Cryoharvesting industry. Harvesting what you may ask? Harvesting organs!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a cryoharvesting industry that harvests organs near cryosleepers.

description:
Download https://mega.nz/file/3952xADa#MhAIy1IUp24-s3oe09dmlH2T5ggmBKimx_1bERofN24

This mod adds industry. Cryoharvesting industry. Harvesting what you may ask? Harvesting organs!

Spoiler

But it's available only near a cryosleeper, just like cryorevival facility - within 10 light years.

Changelog

Spoiler

0.0.2 Tried again, with no positive result.
